summary.text: Nikki Torres is a Republican member of the Washington State Senate who took office on January 9, 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for District 8, where she faces fellow Republican Gabe Galbraith.
Before the Senate she worked in commercial banking and business development and served on the Pasco City Council.

paragraphs.text: Nikki Torres earned a high school diploma from Pasco High School, an associate degree from Columbia Basin College in 2008, a bachelor's degree from the University of Phoenix in 2012, and a graduate degree from the University of Phoenix in 2015.
Her career experience includes commercial banking, business development and consulting.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she spent years in commercial services at Gesa Credit Union helping small businesses and nonprofits, and that she served as president of the Tri-Cities Hispanic Chamber of Commerce.
Torres, according to Ballotpedia, has represented Washington State Senate District 15 since January 9, 2023.
In the same survey, she said she serves as Republican Deputy Floor Leader and has been Assistant Ranking Member on the Operating Budget since 2025.
She listed her campaign's key messages as safe communities, an affordable Washington, and protecting water, farms and dams.
